actions.name: Overwatch Action
actions.description: Set a fixed 30 degree Overwatch cone with a range equal to the range increment of your chosen ranged weapon attack. Until your next activation, make a free action @Trait[interrupt] attack using your ranged weapon against anyone who moves through the overwatch area.
